content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Nurse III (Project Staff Nurse) and 1 for Project Technical Support III (Project Technical Officer).

rows.post_name: Project Technical Support III (Project Technical Officer)

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Nurse III (Project Staff Nurse): Four-year Nursing Course from a recognized Board/University. Registration with State/Indian Nursing Council. Two years experience of Neonatal care/NICU. Desirable: B.Sc. Nursing with NICU experience. Project Technical Support III (Project Technical Officer): Three-year Graduate Degree in relevant subject (BMLT/BSc Microbiology) with three years post-qualification experience OR First Class Four-year Graduate Degree in Engineering/IT/Computer Science with three years experience. Desirable: Experience in clinical research and data management software.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Project Nurse III is scheduled for 29 August 2026, and for Project Technical Support III, it is on 31 August 2026. Candidates should report on these dates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: AIIMS Jodhpur has announced a total of 2 vacancies for the posts of Project Nurse III and Project Technical Support III.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Nurse III post?
faq.answer: For the Project Nurse III post, candidates need a Four-year Nursing Course from a recognized Board/University with State/Indian Nursing Council registration and 2 years of NICU experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the advertised posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 33,600 per month, which includes Rs. 28,000 basic pay and 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly with their documents.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur, Rajasthan, 342005.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview, Document Verification, and potentially a Written Test if required for shortlisting.
